posts.name: Natediggadoggity
posts.cooked:
Powerhound_2000:

I'm excited to play Argent Adept more to finally figure him out myself more. Plus I get hear him singing when his Ongoings come out and hear the instruments play when I use them.  

Personally, I plan to turn the sound effects off whenever I play argent adept. Hearing that pithy little sound effect wheneverr I use an instrument or have him perform kinda feels like it will ruin Argent Adept for me. In my head Argent Adept is such a master of music, that every note made by him is an amazing orchestra that inspires and empowers all heroes that hear it, while demoralizing their enemies. So, a short sound effect ruins what I'm imagining is happening.

Besides that, yes I'm very excited. Even though I play on steam, I may til it's out on apple, so the unlocks are available as soon as I start playing. The puzzles are the best part for me, and solving them with a community is even better.
